children: CBOT grain futures are lower as private firms issue forecasts for next week's WASDE report. They're saying that the USDA will likely drop its outlook for corn and soybean yields. Linn and Associates sees corn production at 15.768 billion bushels, with a yield of 177.98 bushels an acre, while soybeans are at 4.459 billion bushels with a yield of 52 bpa. Allendale Inc. projects a soybean yield of 52.6 bpa with production at 4.5 billion bushels, while corn yield lands at 178.7 bpa with production at 15.8 billion bushels. These forecasts are below where the USDA pegged production and yields last month, with analysts anticipating weather stress to impact crop numbers. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
